with an in-panel card fo
r the API key and an optional proxy.

Stitch is a **remote MCP endpoint**. This plugin connects to it directly with the

There is no helper process, no local port and no launcher script: the plugin adds the row

he harness and reads the credential from the card.
## Tools
The endpoint exposes 16 tools; they register as `mcp__stitch__*`:

| Tool | Purpose |
| :-- | :-- |
| `list_projects` / `get_project` / `create_project` / `delete_proj

ect` | Projects |
| `list_screens` / `get_screen` / `download_file` | Screens and their files |
| `g

enerate_screen_from_text` / `edit_screens` / `generate_variants` | Generate and edit UI |
| `list_de
sign_systems` / `create_design_system` / `create_design_system_from_design_md` / `update_design_syst

em` / `apply_design_system` | Design systems |
| `upload_design_md` | Upload a DESIGN.md |

Use your own profile name when the harness is launched with another one.
## Credentials

Settings → Plugins → **Google Stitch** → paste the key → **Save**. The widget has two
tabs:

- **API Key** — the documented shape, `X-Goog-Api-Key`.
- **OAuth** — `Authorization: Bearer <access

token>`, optionally pinned to a project
with `X-Goog-User-Project`.

Create a key at <https://stitch.withgoogle.com/settings> → **API key** → **Create key**.
The full ke

y is shown only once. The OAuth tab takes an access token, e.g. the output of
`gcloud auth print-acc

only once. The OAuth tab takes an access token, e.g. the output of
`gcloud auth print-access-token`.

Values are stored through the host `credentials` service; the Host half resolves them
into `~/.dsh/d

sh-runtimes/stitch-mcp/config.json`, which the MCP row reads when its
`headers` are composed. Saving

in the card therefore triggers a reload of that one
entry, so the new credential applies **without
restarting the harness**.
## Endpoint and proxy

**The default is a direct connection, and a network that reaches Google needs no
configuration at al

e default is a direct connection, and a network that reaches Google needs no
configuration at all.**

The card's **Use a proxy** switch is the only valve. Switching it on stores
`http://<ip>:<port>` and

routes **only this plugin's Stitch requests** through it:
everything else in the harness — the mode

l API, web search, other MCP servers — keeps
the route it already had. The change applies inside the

running process within a few
seconds, so there is no restart, and nothing is written to `~/.dsh/.en

nning process within a few
seconds, so there is no restart, and nothing is written to `~/.dsh/.env`.

Switching it off stores nothing and takes the plugin out of the path again: Stitch then
connects dir
ectly, or follows the proxy policy you exported for the harness yourself.

If nothing can reach the endpoint, nothing is faked: the MCP row reports its own
transport error, an
d `~/.dsh/dsh-runtimes/stitch-mcp/status.json` says what failed:

## Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Meaning |
| :-- | :-- |
| `server is disconnected` | The transport cannot reach `stitch.
googleapis.com` at all. `status.json` → `error` names the reason (`UND_ERR_CONNECT_TIMEOUT`, `fetch

failed`, …). Give the process a proxy and restart. |
| Tools listed, calls answer “Request is missin
g required authentication credential” | No credential saved yet — paste an API key in the card. The

handshake itself needs no key, which is why the tools appear first. |
| `status.json` says `credenti

al: null` | The card has nothing stored; the host `credentials` service is unreachable. |
| Proxy on
but still unreachable | Check the address in the card, then `status.json` → `proxyError` / `error`.

Switching the proxy off hands Stitch back to the harness policy. |
| `status.json` says `route: "di
rect"` with the switch on | `undici` could not be resolved in this profile, so the switch stays iner

t; `proxyError` says so. Reinstall the plugin. |
| Row gave up after many attempts | The MCP client
stops retrying permanently; saving a credential reloads the entry, and restarting the harness also r
ng permanently; saving a credential reloads the entry, and restarting the harness also re-arms it. |
## Layout

| File | Role |
| :-- | :-- |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Inserts the host entry and the `dsh-mcp-client`

row (direct HTTPS transport, credential headers, reconnect) |
| `index.js` | Host half: resolves cr
edentials, keeps `config.json` / `status.json`, installs the per-origin proxy wrapper, reloads the r

ow on a change |
| `proxy.js` | Per-origin dispatcher wrapper: routes `stitch.googleapis.com` only,

and only while the card's switch is on |
| `client.js` | Client half: the credential card in `plugin

s.bundle.config`, with `I18N` dictionaries |
| `locale/{en,zh}.json` | Plugin title and description

per locale |
| `CHANGELOG.md` | Release history |
| `market/listing.json` | DSH Plugin Market submis

| `CHANGELOG.md` | Release history |
| `market/listing.json` | DSH Plugin Market submission entry |
